question: Related Questions Q. I recently attended a wedding at at the end a few brothers were called to the stage to take photographs. Some people were using their mobiles to take photos, some people digital cameras and their was a video camera too. A brother advised us that we should avoid posing for these photos but he did not give a reason as he was not 100% sure on the ruling. A few other brothers said they will only be saving these on their mobiles and not publishing them in anyway and some simply said there is nothing wrong and that the ruling was for something in the past about idol worshiping and that they will not be using to idol worship. Can you please advise on the correct ruling on this issue and please send me some hadith and Quran aayaats which help to convince everyone either way. May ALLAH reward you all for your efforts and may ALLAH make the academy a source of knowledge for all. please rememeber me in your duas. 4146 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21057 Country: India Title: is it haram to have artificial whigs put on ?? Is the namaz offered by these men acceptable?? please reply as soon as possible. Question: assalam walaikum..is it haram to have artificial whigs put on ?? Is the namaz offered by these men acceptable?? please reply as soon as possible. khudahafiz. Answer ID: 21057 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 686/481/L=1431) It is haram to put on an artificial wig made of human hair. و قد فصله أصحابنا فقالوا: إن وصلت بشعر آدمى فهو حرام بلا خلاف (مرقاة : 8/294). In this state salah will be makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
